display.name: RCP · Service health
display.description: Landing page: is the API broken or slow right now? Traffic, errors and latency only. Every other question has its own dashboard (tag app:rcp). Generated by docs/observability/signoz/tools/build_dashboards.py; edit the generator, not the JSON.

display.name: Requests
display.description: API requests in the selected period.

display.name: Error rate
display.description: Requests that ended in a 5xx or an unhandled exception. Alert 1 fires at 5 %.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true

display.name: Failed requests
display.description: Absolute number behind the error rate.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true

display.name: p95 latency
display.description: 95 % of requests were faster than this. Alert 2 fires at 2 s.

display.name: Browser errors
display.description: JavaScript errors reported by the frontend. Alert 6 watches a spike.

display.name: Error rate %
display.description: On a quiet deployment one failure moves this a lot; read it with the request volume.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true

display.name: Responses by status class
display.description: Green is served, amber (4xx) is a client or permission problem, red (5xx) is ours. Single codes: RCP · Endpoints and RCP · Security & access.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND response_status_code LIKE '2%'
service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND response_status_code LIKE '3%'
service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND response_status_code LIKE '4%'
service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND response_status_code LIKE '5%'

display.name: Endpoints with errors
display.description: Most failing first. Counts every failed request, so it adds up to the red tile at the top; a request that failed before it reached a route shows n/a as its route. Details: RCP · Endpoints.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true

display.name: Slowest endpoints
display.description: The 10 slowest by p95, with the number of requests so one slow call does not mislead.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND http.route EXISTS

display.name: Latest failed requests
display.description: Newest first. Click a row to open the trace.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service.name AND kind_string = 'Server' AND has_error = true

display.name: Browser errors over time
display.description: Reported by the React app through POST /client-errors.
